- action "accept": only when the oracle output is green and the request is satisfied.

When an owner needs to, its whole submission is rejected and you receive the request (test title, change kind, owner's reason) under "Previous rounds". To allow it, list the exact title in approveTestChanges and instruct that owner again; approving means you accept that the previously specified behaviour changes, so approve only what the request actually calls for. Otherwise, instruct the owner to achieve the request without that change.

acceptanceTest (optional) is a complete vitest file that tests a unit through its exports. Your acceptance tests currently in place are shown to you each turn; to delete one, list its unit in retractAcceptanceTests.

steps.instruction: Change formatList so that todos that have a `due` value (a non-empty string) are rendered before todos without one. Do this as a stable partition: within the dated group and within the undated group, keep the relative order the todos had in the input array (don't re-sort dated items by date or anything else). Leave the rendering of each individual line (formatTodo) and everything else about the output exactly as it is now. Don't mutate the input array. Add unit tests in src/format.test.ts covering this.

input.reason: Rendering order lives in formatList. Doing a stable partition there (dated todos first) puts the change in one unit, and any order that list() already applies upstream stays intact within each group.
